about: A colored dot and a word that report what something is doing now. The word carries the meaning, so the status is readable without the color.

effect.about: A halo around the dot, in the palette's solid at half opacity. `pulse` animates it, the usual signal for a live connection, and stops when the reader prefers reduced motion.
effect.title: Effects

palette.about: The dot in each semantic palette, next to a word for a state a caller would map to it.
palette.title: Palettes

sentence.about: The root is a `span`, so a status is valid inside a paragraph. At `inherit` the word takes the font of the sentence, and the dot and the gap follow it.
sentence.title: In a sentence

size.about: Each size sets the label text style one size smaller, and `inherit` takes the surrounding font. The dot and the gap scale with the text.
size.title: Sizes

title: Status
